subjectLines.text: Useful ideas for summer event kits
Build a better summer event kit
What should go in the event bag?

previewText: Choose useful branded products and make the next summer event kit easier to plan.
body:
Summer events give marketing teams many options for branded merchandise. The challenge is choosing products that make sense for the audience and remain useful after the event.

A good kit starts with the setting. Attendees may need a bottle during the day, a pouch for cables and small items, or a tote for everything they collect. Choosing products around those needs can create a more practical experience than filling a bag with as many items as possible.

Brightmark offers drinkware, bags, and tech accessories that can be combined into a focused kit. The team can also assemble the items and ship kits to individual recipients. This makes the same plan useful for in-person events, remote attendees, and distributed teams.

It also helps to narrow the list early. Three or four useful pieces can be easier to pack, explain, and distribute than a large collection of unrelated products. The final choices should reflect the audience, budget, and event date.

Share those three details with Brightmark. The team will use them to create a short list of products for the summer event and help organize the kit around the people receiving it.
